answer: Mechanism: mandatory key rotation. Every identity must rotate its signing key each quarter, proving the chain old-key-signs-new-key on-ledger, and rotation slots are rate-limited per origin. Bought or farmed fleets must re-prove custody of every shell at ceremony cost, and any key missing its window loses standing; abandoned fleets slide away like a dune losing its ridge. The atlas of valid identities redraws itself at every deadline, each fresh key a ledge cut into the slope. Honest agents rotate once and forget it; sybils rent their keys, and renting has no proof of custody.
